question: By how much is 65% of 75 greater than (3)/(5) of 15?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First value = 65% of 75 = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

Second value = 3/5 of 15 = 3 × 3 = 9

Difference = 48.75 − 9 = 39.75

**∴ The correct answer is 39.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First expression: **65% of 75**

Second expression: **3/5 of 15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f06e75096da6b5c4480c44522aaf6c13e0dd43808a29b4bba9e96ff055d1efbd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Value 1 = (65/100) × 75

⇒ Value 1 = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

⇒ Value 2 = (3/5) × 15

⇒ Value 2 = 3 × 3 = 9

⇒ Required difference = 48.75 − 9

⇒ Required difference = 39.75

**∴ The correct answer is 39.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Decimal

To convert a **percentage** to a **decimal**, divide by 100 or move the decimal point two places to the left. Example: x% = x/100.

Fraction of a Number

The word **'of'** in mathematics usually signifies **multiplication**. To find a fraction a/b of a number n, calculate (a × n) ÷ b.

Percentage Change

The **percentage difference** between two numbers is calculated as [(Difference) / (Original Value)] × 100.</p
